artifact_observations.reasoning: The text within the logos on both pucks is nonsensical and illegible. The characters are malformed and do not form readable words, a common artifact in AI-generated images where text rendering fails.

The image suffers from general softness and lack of sharp focus, particularly around the edges of the pucks and the details of the logos. This resembles low-resolution upscaling or generation blur rather than optical depth-of-field blur.
The printed logo on the right puck appears to 'smear' into the black rubber texture slightly, lacking the crisp edge separation expected of a physical print or sticker.

alignment_reasoning: The image aligns extremely well with the 'puck' class. All testable geometric and visual checkpoints (disk shape, matte black color, presence of logos) are met. The score is near-perfect because the subject matter is correctly identified and structurally sound, despite the inability to verify side ridges due to camera angle.
